abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify Weather Update Flow Upon Initial Alert Confirmation (Positive)
Module: Weather Updates
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - User is on the main screen of the GoodWeatherKM application.
- - Application is loaded and waiting for initial alert.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the “OK” button to be visible on the alert.
2. Tap on the “OK” button.
3. Wait for the “Wind” text to appear on the screen.
4. Swipe down on the screen.
5. Tap on the “Update” text view.

Expected Result:
- - “OK” button is visible and responsive.
- - After tapping “OK,” the alert disappears, and the main weather screen is displayed.
- - “Wind” text becomes visible, indicating weather data is shown.
- - Swipe down refreshes or reveals more weather information.
- - Tapping “Update” triggers a refresh, and latest weather data is displayed.

Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- - User is on the main screen of the GoodWeatherKM application.
- - Search functionality is accessible.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the “Search” button.
2. Wait for the “Search location” edit text field to be visible.
3. Enter a location string with 256 characters (e.g., a repetition of "A" 256 times).
4. Attempt to submit or search for this string.
5. Observe application response.

Expected Result:
- - Application accepts only a reasonable number of characters (e.g., truncates at maximum allowed length) or shows a validation message for excessive input.
- - No unexpected behavior (such as freeze or crash) occurs.
- - If validation exists, a message is shown indicating input exceeds maximum length or is invalid.
- - No irrelevant or unexpected results appear.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Enter Valid User Information and Complete Form Actions Successfully
Module: Demo iOS - User Information Entry
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - The app is installed and running on the iOS device.
- - The user is on the screen where the Full Name and First Name fields are displayed.

Test Steps:
1. Wait until the Full Name field is visible.
2. Enter "DemoFull" in the Full Name field.
3. Wait for 2 seconds.
4. Enter "DemoFirst" in the First Name field.
5. Wait until the Done button on the keyboard is visible.
6. Tap the Done button on the keyboard.
7. Wait until the Clear button is visible.
8. Tap the Clear button.
9. Tap the Controls tab.
10. Wait until the Male option is visible.
11. Tap the Female radio button.
12. Tap the Screens tab.
13. Wait until the Open Modal Sheet option is visible.
14. Tap on Open Modal Sheet.
15. Wait until the Close button is visible.
16. Swipe down on the screen to dismiss the modal sheet.
17. Wait until Open Detail Screen is visible.
18. Wait for 2 seconds.
19. Tap on Open Detail Screen.
20. Wait until the Push Another Screen button is visible.
21. Tap on Push Another Screen.
22. Wait until the Nested Detail screen is visible.
23. Tap on the Back navigation button.
24. Wait until the Detail Screen is visible.
25. Tap on the Back navigation button.
26. Wait for 2 seconds.
27. Tap on the Form tab.

Expected Result:
- - The Full Name and First Name fields accept and display the entered values.
- - Form fields are cleared upon tapping Clear.
- - Controls tab and radio button selections work as expected.
- - Modal sheet displays and can be dismissed as expected.
- - Navigation between screens and tabs is successful without errors.
- - No crashes or unexpected behaviors are observed throughout the process.
